data.title: Gift Card Merge and Transfer Anomaly Detection
data.description: Detects suspicious gift card merge and transfer activity indicating value consolidation from multiple illicit sources. NRF RFT FT1202 documents that fraudsters transfer value from multiple illicitly obtained gift cards to a single legitimate card — e.g., 20 cards with $5 merged into one $255 card. This consolidation is a key Control phase technique enabling subsequent monetization. Detection signals include merge velocity, source card count, and correlation with recent suspicious balance check activity.

detection.condition: count(distinct source_card) by destination_card >= 3 AND timeframe < 60 minutes

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Gift Card Merge and Transfer Anomaly Detection
// NRF FT1202: Monitor for suspicious multi-card merges
#repo="retail" #event_type="giftcard_transactions"
transaction_type="merge" OR transaction_type="transfer" OR transaction_type="consolidate"
| groupBy(destination_card, function=[count(as=merge_count), count(field=source_card, distinct=true, as=source_card_count), sum(transfer_amount, as=total_transferred), min(@timestamp, as=first_merge), max(@timestamp, as=last_merge), collect([source_ip])], span=1h)
| source_card_count >= 3
| sort(source_card_count, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Gift Card Merge and Transfer Anomaly Detection")`
`comment("NRF FT1202: Monitor for suspicious multi-card merges")`
index=retail sourcetype=giftcard:transactions
  transaction_type IN ("merge", "transfer", "consolidate")
| stats count AS merge_count,
        dc(source_card) AS source_card_count,
        sum(transfer_amount) AS total_transferred,
        min(_time) AS first_merge,
        max(_time) AS last_merge,
        values(source_ip) AS source_ips
  BY destination_card
| eval window_minutes = round((last_merge - first_merge) / 60, 1)
| where source_card_count >= 3 AND window_minutes < 60
| sort - source_card_count
queries.sql:
-- SQL: Gift card merge anomaly detection
SELECT
    destination_card,
    COUNT(DISTINCT source_card) AS source_card_count,
    SUM(transfer_amount) AS total_transferred,
    MIN(transfer_timestamp) AS first_merge,
    MAX(transfer_timestamp) AS last_merge,
    DATEDIFF(minute, MIN(transfer_timestamp), MAX(transfer_timestamp)) AS window_minutes
FROM gift_card_transfers
WHERE transfer_timestamp >= DATEADD(day, -7, GETDATE())
  AND transaction_type IN ('merge', 'transfer', 'consolidate')
GROUP BY destination_card
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT source_card) >= 3
   AND DATEDIFF(minute, MIN(transfer_timestamp), MAX(transfer_timestamp)) < 60
ORDER BY source_card_count DESC

references: NRF Retail Fraud Taxonomy v1.0 (November 2024) — FT1202 Gift Card Merge
NRF FD1006 Velocity Attributes, FD1010 Transaction Data
falsepositives: Corporate gift card consolidation during employee reward program administration
Legitimate customer merging multiple small-value gift cards received as gifts
Gift card balance cleanup during promotional campaigns
